item.title: Techniques for Including External HTML Content in Web Pages
item.description:
“Techniques for Including External HTML Content in Web Pages”

Client-Side Inclusion Methods (JavaScript/jQuery)

The primary way to achieve this without a full server-side framework involves client-side fetching and DOM manipulation.

1. Using jQuery’s .load() Function

One established method uses the jQuery library to asynchronously fetch and insert content from an external file into a specified element.

Implementation Details:

In your main HTML file (index.html), include jQuery and define placeholder div elements for the header and footer.
